findingIndex.title: Workspace 'Queue telemetry sampler delayed' is derived from Home page loads, not from the worker sampler
'Queue retry storm' counts this workspace's re-observed conditions, not queue retries; its drill-down lists only itself; Home counts it twice
Personal storage add-on obligation: never auto-resolves, can be manually 'resolved' while live, drawer blames platform infrastructure
Report failure condition auto-resolves while a newer version is failed or still processing
/v1/ops/* enforces role only; plan/entitlement is enforced in the web alone
Worker scheduled sweeps send x-cron-secret; the API authenticates x-proovra-integration-cron-secret (deterministic 401)
Detail and list reads share one request counter: after any action with the drawer open the list never refreshes and Refresh stays disabled
Scheduled Operations sweep only ranks the 500 oldest workspaces
Per-workspace worker-heartbeat conditions never auto-resolve and open SLA cycles
GET /v1/ops/health gives any workspace member (VIEWER, FREE) process-global configuration and unscoped counts
Web bulk outcome counts SUCCEEDED; the API returns COMPLETED — every successful bulk run is shown as failed
Default Grouped view: group drawer has only 'Close'; no actions and no route to the condition drawer
'Retry after exhausted failure' (supersede) is never offered; the offered action tells the user to use it
Expected 403 refusals become a customer-visible 'Identity security condition'
Failures for personal records stored with team_id NULL become LEGACY_UNSCOPED and are invisible to their owner
Raw error text becomes the customer summary (verbatim to VIEWERs) and part of the fingerprint
'Search index reconciliation failing' opens when no reconciliation has ever run (and when work is already scheduled)
Sources declared PROBE_AUTO_RESOLVE that nothing closes (one is permanently stuck)
TSA and OTS failure conditions resolve on any non-FAILED status (NULL, PENDING, unvalidated STAMPED)
Drawer/page UX and accessibility: no focus move/trap, wrong focus restore, English-only in de/ar, no deep link, Load-more in grouped view
Web capability envelope disagrees with API authority (revoked rows counted, expired access, suspended org)
Real BullMQ failures and retries never reach any Operations surface; persisted retryCount is hard-coded 0
Storage add-on condition wording/category: PENDING titled 'still billing', MANUAL title replaced, category STORAGE
Queue replay eligibility admits completed jobs; BullMQ then refuses and the API reports 404 'job_not_found'
/v1/investigation/diagnostics returns another tenant's queue job failure text to any workspace member
/v1/runtime/secrets-health gives any member (VIEWER) the secrets posture: secret names, presence, AWS secret/region, fallback mode
No writer produces PLATFORM scope; provider-credential conditions are stored LEGACY_UNSCOPED with an hourly fingerprint and no resolver
Report-failure recovery is proven by a DB row without verifying the stored object
Resolve is a dead control for sources that require a resolution note: the web sends no note and has no field
'Stop notifying' (suppress) hides a live source-truth condition with no confirmation and no recorded reason
Remediation guidance and deep links are keyed by category, not source: wrong guidance and generic targets
POST /v1/ops/workspace-reconcile reports started:false for the request that ran the reconciliation
Projected titles replace stored titles with the source label: 120 distinct conditions all read 'Governance policy condition'
Enterprise has no organization roll-up; Operations is strictly per workspace
Native Operations: no reset on workspace switch, no refresh on foreground, English-only
A failed grouped read renders '0 groups · 0 conditions … match these filters' in the default view
